$comment: Validates docs/spec/_source/icons.json, the rows of table T-109 (the whole of the icons, FR-029) (CR-857 step 2). The rows are design facts, not names, so they live outside the names dictionary docs/spec/_source/glossary.json.
English is the primary text and Japanese its translation, as in glossary.schema.json: every description has a sibling x-description-ja.
Read by docs/spec/_source/glossary_json_to_md.py, which prints table T-109 into docs/spec/_assets/tbl-glossary.md, and by tools/generate_icon_roster.py, which writes the icon roster into src/.
title: The icon rows manuscript
description: One object per row of table T-109, in print order. A cell that holds Japanese is a language dictionary; a cell that holds a row id, a mark or a dash is a plain string. The table prose, caption and column headings stay in docs/spec/_source/glossary-tables.json.
x-description-ja: 表 T-109 の 1 行に 1 つの物。印字の順。日本語を持つ欄は言語の辞書、行 ID・印・ダッシュを持つ欄は言語の無い文字列。表の散文・見出し・列名は docs/spec/_source/glossary-tables.json が持つ。

$comment.description: Notes for whoever edits this manuscript, one line per note. Not printed.
$comment.x-description-ja: この原稿を直す人への注記。1 行に 1 つ。印字しない。

cell.description: A plain string with no Japanese character, or a language dictionary.
cell.x-description-ja: 日本語の字を持たない文字列か、言語の辞書。

id.description: The row id IC-n: the only join between this table and figure F-019.
id.x-description-ja: 行 ID IC-n。この表と図 F-019 をつなぐ唯一の継ぎ目。

surfaces.description: The surfaces the icon stands on (column 面), as row ids of table T-103. The table prints the name each row prints, so no new surface name can be written here.
surfaces.x-description-ja: アイコンが立つ面（列「面」）。表 T-103 の行 ID で持つ。表はその行が印字する名を印字するので、ここで新しい面の名を書けない。

group.description: Column 群: the block the entry sits in on its surface, or an em dash. Never printed on the screen (FR-053).
group.x-description-ja: 列「群」: 面の上で入口が入る塊。無ければダッシュ。画面に刷らない（FR-053）。

entryTo.description: Column 何の入口か: what the icon is an entry to.
entryTo.x-description-ja: 列「何の入口か」: アイコンが何の入口か。

authority.description: Column 正: the requirement or row that holds the rule.
authority.x-description-ja: 列「正」: 規則を持つ要求か行。

switches.description: Column 切り替える設定値: the settings row the entry rewrites, or an em dash.
switches.x-description-ja: 列「切り替える設定値」: 入口が書き換える設定値の行。無ければダッシュ。

arms.description: Column 構え: the row of table T-023b the pointer enters when the entry is pressed, or an em dash.
arms.x-description-ja: 列「構え」: 入口を押したときポインタが入る表 T-023b の行。無ければダッシュ。

unspacedCells.description: Fields whose cell closes on the pipe with no space before it, kept so the printed table stayed byte-identical to the hand-written one at the switch (CR-857 step 2).
unspacedCells.x-description-ja: 欄の閉じの縦線の前に空白を置かない欄のキー。切り替えのとき、印字した表を手書きの表とバイト単位で同じに保つために持つ（CR-857 の段 2）。
